Sustainability Data Platform for Fashion and Textile

Sustainability Software for Fashion and Textiles

Reduce your environmental impact with expert-driven sustainability insights. Measure, report, and take action on your sustainability data — all in one comprehensive platform designed for the fashion and textiles industry.

Carbon Accounting | ESG Reporting | Product LCA | Supply Chain Decarbonisation

Trusted by global fashion leaders

Your One Stop Sustainability Platform

Carbon Accounting

Learn More

Automate Your Fashion Carbon Accounting (Scopes 1, 2, and 3) with Audit-Grade Accuracy.

Learn More

ESG Reporting

Learn More

Ensure compliance, get tailored reports for fashion and meet global sustainability standards effortlessly.

Learn More

Product LCA

Learn More

Automate Product Environmental Impact Analysis for Carbon, Water, and Land Use Footprints, Even with Minimal Data.

Learn More

Supply Chain Decarbonisation

Learn More

Proactively plan and simulate reductions to make informed decisions confidently. Identify high-ROI alternatives for high-emission areas.

Learn More

Traceability

Learn More

Showcase your environmental footprints and engage customers with digital passports, smart widgets and QR codes.

Learn More

Your entire sustainability journey on one integrated platform

Calculating product supply chain emissions is complex. GreenStitch does the work for you, fast

  • Understand your complete environmental impact including scope 3
  • Seamlessly Streamline Data Collection and Management Internally and from Suppliers, while Filling Data Gaps with Smart Automation
  • Integrate with existing ERPs & inventory databases, previous sustainability reports
  • Calculate emissions using our integrated database and up-to-date standards, methodologies, and conversion factors

Set and track Science aligned targets, Stay ahead of legal regulations and track your decarbonization progress continuously in one place

  • Quickly estimate hotspots and get meaningful insights to reduce emissions
  • Foresee trends, and get overall ESG performance snapshots of your organisation against industry
  • Track: Set & track emissions targets aligned with SBTI, CDP, TCFD, UNFCCC
  • Advanced dashboards enable real-time, compliant reporting: internally and externally
  • Achieve carbon neutrality with multiple insetting & offsetting options

Differentiate your products, uncover commercial insights to market your sustainability results

  • Get ahead of future regulations and carbon taxes, find cost-savings in your supply chain
  • Increase conversion rates, gain new customer base
  • Find lower-carbon suppliers and monetary opportunities in reducing emissions towards net zero

GreenStitch Aligned with Global Standards

Gain new opportunities with GreenStitch

Stay Ahead of Regulations, Win New clients and cut cost

Become Future Ready

Future-proof your business amidst evolving regulations (PEF-CR, AGEC, DPP, EPR, extended producer responsibility)

Improve investor relations

60% of investors say they will increase their investments in companies that prioritise sustainability over the next five years

Improve Brand Image

94% of buyers are more likely to be loyal to a company that is transparent about its environmental and social impact

Mitigate financial risks

Companies that do not account for and manage their carbon footprint may face up to 27% higher operating costs and potential revenue loss

Selected by top brands and manufacturers across the globe

GreenStitch has been a game-changer for us at Nahar Spinning Mills Limited. Their platform has simplified our ESG reporting and GHG Accounting and reduction processes, making our job easier and more efficient. Highly recommended for streamlining sustainability efforts.

Sambhav Oswal

MD, Nahar Spinning Mills Limited

In our collaboration with GreenStitch for the past half-year, their unwavering commitment to fostering transparency in fashion and prioritizing environmental responsibility has been nothing short of impressive. Their innovative and most granular approach to address the challenges associated with textile waste, by empowering stakeholders to take informed decisions towards reducing their carbon footprint is commendable. We look forward to a continued partnership with Greenstitch in the future.

Anjali Krishnan

Program Manager, IDH

Understanding GHG emissions is crucial for textile companies, we evaluated multiple consultants and tech players and we have found GreenStitch to be the best partner for assessing our emissions at SRP and Ecoline. Our collaboration with GreenStitch has been exceptional. Their user-friendly platform has not only made Environmental emissions more understandable but has also highlighted emissions hotspots at SRP. This valuable insight will guide our efforts to reduce emissions in these areas. We highly recommend GreenStitch for their expertise and invaluable support in our sustainability journey.

Senthil Sankar

MD, Shree Renga Polymers, Ecoline
